implement_stream_logger: implement a concrete subclass of StreamLoggerInterface to log robot sensor data to MCAP files
start_logging_session: start a new logging session with start_session using a task_id and start timestamp in nanoseconds
write_proto_message: write a protobuf message to the log file on a specific topic with publish and log timestamps
stop_session_and_finalize: stop the current logging session and finalize the output file with stop_session using a stop timestamp
check_recording_state: check if the stream logger is recording with is_recording or if a session has started with is_session_started
